name: What's the process for getting a quote for deck maintenance from Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What's the process for getting a quote for deck maintenance from Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for obtaining a quote for deck maintenance from Frasheski Construction involves a few straightforward steps. First, you can contact us via phone or our website to schedule an on-site consultation. During this visit, our experts will thoroughly inspect your deck, discuss your specific concerns and goals, and assess its condition. Following the inspection, we will provide you with a detailed, no-obligation estimate outlining the recommended services, materials, and associated costs. We aim for transparency to ensure you understand every aspect of the proposed work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contact us to schedule an on-site consultation where our experts will inspect your deck and provide a detailed, no-obligation estimate for recommended services.
